source_tree_definition: SHA-256 over sorted tracked and untracked paths plus a NUL separator, file bytes and a trailing NUL separator for each path, excluding .agents, .git, node_modules, .fallow, dist and out.

observations.result: Routine gate passes: state, contracts, architecture, accessibility, layout, typecheck, 98 tests with 569 expectations, Knip and changed-file Fallow.

Full local gate passes: state remains honest at 1/19 checkpoints and 196 rows, contracts/architecture/distribution/accessibility/layout/typecheck/tests/quality-program/compile/Knip/Fallow all pass; Bun test reports 98 tests with 569 expectations and report-only Fallow health 88.4/A with only the inherited scripts/status.ts collectRow advisory.
6 focused tests pass with 32 expectations, including setext headings, multiline paragraphs/quotes, thematic breaks, fenced tilde code, safe inline segments and the Expo portability guard.
No issues in the changed source increment.
No unused files, exports or dependencies reported.

implemented: Moved the safe Markdown preview parser behind src/shared/ui/markdown-preview.ts and kept src/core/markdown-preview.ts as a compatibility re-export, so a future Expo renderer can consume the same data-only block and inline-segment contract.

Added setext headings, multiline paragraphs and callouts, thematic breaks, tilde fences and safe inline formatting/link/wiki-link segments; the Electron renderer creates textContent-only DOM nodes, displays link targets without navigation and keeps footnotes, math, diagrams and raw HTML visibly unsupported.
Added workspaceBlock(id), the stable shared-ui export surface, an architecture-manifest entry and a test that rejects Electron, DOM and React Native imports from the shared TypeScript source.
Added bun run check:fast and README.md guidance distinguishing routine checks from the longer full quality and packaged-release gates.
limitations: Reference Obsidian Markdown differential/reopen behavior, screen-reader/input/IME validation and Windows/Linux visible renderer behavior remain pending external validation.

The preview intentionally implements a safe supported subset; unsupported executable or renderer-owned dialects remain text-labeled and no link target is made navigable until a host supplies an explicit allowlist policy.
The current full quality gate still reports the inherited scripts/status.ts collectRow complexity advisory; the changed-file strict Fallow gate is clean.
